title: THE GUN ARM FOLLOWS THE BUILD
why: Following v20.01: the arm that holds the gun was the same thickness on every body. On Broad it is thicker and on Curved slimmer, so the arm matches the shoulders it hangs from; Lean is unchanged.
now: Broad has a thicker gun arm and Curved a slimmer one.

edits.replacement: wc.fillStyle=coat; if(_BLD==='broad') wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.9,6,5.8); else if(_BLD==='curved') wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.0,6,4.0); else wc.fillRect(1+ext,-2.4,6,4.8);   // v16.xx: a thicker arm on Broad, a slimmer one on Curved
